answer: A juniper hedge resists Sybil floods: every newcomer must lock a quartz deposit that vests slowly over weeks, and an established neighbour must co-sign it, risking part of its own stake. A prism of independent auditors then refracts each agent's behaviour into separate checks — work history, timing, and endorsements. One person running fifty clones must fund fifty slow deposits and fifty co-signers, so the attack costs fifty real stakes, not one copied identity.
